keyword.en: which concrete pumps list pipe diameter
keyword.zh: 哪些混凝土泵印了输送管径

title.en: Which Pinjin Pumps Print a Delivery-Pipe Diameter
title.zh: 哪些品锦泵印了输送管内径

description.en: Only some Xingtai concrete pump pages print an inner diameter. The others leave that cell blank.
description.zh: 只有一部分邢台混凝土泵页面印了内径。其余页面这一格是空的。

h1.en: Which Pinjin Pumps Print a Delivery-Pipe Diameter
h1.zh: 哪些品锦泵印了输送管内径

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints a delivery-pipe diameter on only some concrete pumps in Xingtai. Electric 20 prints 80 mm. Electric 15 prints 100–125 mm. The integrated mixer, HBT8018, HBT80-16 and LZ-60 print 100 / 125 mm. Electric 30, Electric 40, Diesel 30, Diesel 120 and LZ-80 do not print a pipe diameter. A blank cell is not filled from a neighbouring model.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械只在邢台的部分混凝土泵上印输送管内径。电动20为 80 mm。电动15为 100–125 mm。搅拌泵一体机、HBT8018、HBT80-16 和 LZ-60 为 100 / 125 mm。电动30、电动40、柴油30、柴油120和 LZ-80 没有印管径。空白格不能用相邻型号来填。

body.en: Treat each printed diameter as page-specific. Electric 20's 80 mm does not become the default small-pump pipe, because Electric 15 prints 100–125 mm. The four pages that print 100 / 125 mm still keep their own output and distance. B500S-83D prints delivery hose as Standard and does not print a millimetre diameter.
body.zh: 每个印出的管径只属于该页。电动20的 80 mm 不是小型泵的默认管径，因为电动15印的是 100–125 mm。印了 100 / 125 mm 的四页仍要保留自己的产量和距离。B500S-83D 的输送胶管写的是“标准”，没有印毫米管径。

heading.en: Pages that leave the cell out

body.en: If you open Diesel 40, Electric 50 or Electric 60 and do not see a delivery-pipe row, stop. Hebei Pinjin Machinery did not print one there. The parts category sells pipe by confirming the pump model. That commercial line is not a hidden diameter for the pump sheet.
body.zh: 如果打开柴油40、电动50或电动60却看不到输送管行，就停在这里。河北品锦机械没有在那里印管径。配件分类要求对照泵型号后再确认管子。这句商务说明不是泵参数页上隐藏的管径。

body.en: Send the model name through /en/contact/ when the concrete pump page has no diameter. Do not assume 80 mm or 125 mm. The factory address for Hebei Pinjin Machinery is Renze Industrial Park, Xingtai.
body.zh: 混凝土泵页面没有管径时，请通过 /zh/contact/ 发送型号名称。不要假设 80 mm 或 125 mm。河北品锦机械的工厂地址在邢台任泽工业园区。

answer.en: 80 mm. That figure is on the Electric 20 page only.
answer.zh: 80 mm。这个数字只在电动20页面上。

question.en: Do HBT8018 and LZ-60 print the same diameter text?
question.zh: HBT8018 和 LZ-60 的管径文字一样吗？

answer.en: Both print 100 / 125 mm. Their motors, output and distance labels are still different.
answer.zh: 两边都印 100 / 125 mm。电机、产量和距离标题仍然不同。

question.en: Does Diesel 120 print a pipe diameter?

answer.en: No. The Diesel 120 specification table has no delivery-pipe row.
answer.zh: 没有。柴油120的规格表没有输送管行。

question.en: Is Standard on B500S-83D a millimetre size?
question.zh: B500S-83D 上的“标准”是毫米尺寸吗？

answer.en: No. The cell says Standard. It does not print a millimetre figure.
answer.zh: 不是。这一格写的是标准，没有印毫米数字。
